study type: Experimental animal study with in vitro cell culture component
cohort: The study cohort included rats following coronary ligation and H9C2 cells (a rat heart cell line) subjected to hypoxic stress.
finding: A single intravenous dose of acellular hAF led to a nearly sixfold decrease in both infarct size and fibrosis in rats, and improved cell viability, mitochondrial membrane stability, and reduced apoptosis in H9C2 cells under hypoxic stress.
